capabilities: Render PlantUML, Structurizr, and Mermaid diagrams from pumler code blocks
Insert rendered SVG into notes via the Pumler rendering API
Apply per-diagram light, dark, or auto themes
Cache the 30 most recently rendered SVGs on disk with LRU pruning
Show a collapsible summary row and a zoomable preview modal
disambiguation: It only processes pumler fenced code blocks and does not replace Obsidian's native Mermaid renderer or process plain mermaid, plantuml, or structurizr fences.
extras: Privacy warning: all diagram source is sent to the public Pumler API and must never be used for source that must stay on the device; an online editor is available at pumler.com.
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid natively, so rendering PlantUML or Structurizr normally requires running local services, and no single code-block format covers all three languages.

relations.evidence: It does not replace Obsidian's native mermaid renderer

summary: Code-block diagram renderer that sends PlantUML, Structurizr DSL, and Mermaid source to the Pumler API and inserts the returned SVG into notes.
